==What is Lojban?==

{{Side box|style=width:300px;|text=<table>
<tr><td>'''nelci'''</td><td>x1 likes x2.</td></tr>
<tr><td>'''patfu'''</td><td>x1 is a father of x2.</td></tr>
<tr><td>'''mi nelci do'''</td><td>I like you.</td></tr>
<tr><td>'''mi patfu do'''</td><td>I'm your father.</td></tr>
<tr><td>'''do nelci ma'''</td><td>What do you like?</td></tr>
<tr><td>'''ma nelci mi'''</td><td>Who likes me?</td></tr>
<tr><td>'''do patfu ma'''&emsp;</td><td>Who are you a father of?</td></tr>
</table>}}

[[Image:yt-evarusar.png|240x134px|'''Beauty in the artifice''': an introduction to Lojban by [https://bitsfair.com/ Ewa]|link=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6kI__OTFn0o|thumb]]

Lojban is a carefully constructed spoken language. It has been developed since 1987 by a community of logic and language enthusiasts, building on work that began in the 1950s with the [https://www.loglan.org Loglan] language.

* Lojban's grammar is based on simple rules, and its linguistic features are inspired by predicate logic.
* Lojban has words called [[attitudinals]] which function similar to emoticons and emoji, expressing emotions and nuance. '''ue''' indicates surprise; '''ba'u''' admits you're exaggerating.
* You can be as vague or as detailed as you like. Tense (past, present, future) and number (singular, plural) are optional by default.
* Lojban is machine parsable: The syntactic structure of a sentence is unambiguous and can be checked with software.
* There is a community of speakers who continue to explore and expand Lojban's possibilities, writing, translating, and making music in it.

===Lojban means different things to different people===

* a new perspective on language
* a way to discipline your thinking
* a medium for socialization and art
* a domain for exploring the intersection of human language and software
* a test-bed for linguistic experimentation

What will Lojban mean for you?

== Who we are ==
[[File:cll-1.1.png|thumb|''The Complete Lojban Language'', published by the LLG|link=https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_book.pdf]]

This wiki is hosted by the '''[[Logical Language Group]]''' (LLG), also known as '''la .lojbangirz.''' — a non-profit organization founded in 1987 to promote the scientific study of the relationships between language, thought and human culture. LLG is recognized as a 501(c)(3) educational and scientific charity. 

The LLG and this web site is run entirely by volunteers, and hosting costs are covered by members and donors. See [[Logical Language Group]] for how to contact the organization, attend the annual meeting, become a member, or donate.

== Official publications ==
''The Complete Lojban Language'' (the "CLL"), by John Woldemar Cowan, is the official reference grammar, published by the LLG and available in several formats:
* [https://www.amazon.com/dp/0966028325 hardcover]
* [https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_book.pdf PDF] ([https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_cover.pdf PDF cover])
* [https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1.epub EPUB] and [https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1.mobi MOBI] (for Kindle and other ebook readers)
* In HTML: [https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-section-chunks/ one file per section], [https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-chapter-chunks/ one file per chapter], [https://lojban.org/publications/cll/cll_v1.1_xhtml-no-chunks/ one big file]

The CLL is is easiest to read once you already understand some Lojban. It does not teach vocabulary, style, or colloquial usage.

''What Is Lojban? (.i la lojban mo)'' by Nick Nicholas and John Woldemar Cowan, provides a tutorial approach to the language:
* [https://www.amazon.com/dp/0966028317 paperback]

Lojban usage has changed over time. Some of these changes have been described by the '''BPFK''' (''baupla fuzykamni'', or "Language Planning Committee"), which was formed in 2003, or the '''LFK''' (''la lojbau fuzykamni''), which succeeded the BPFK in 2018. One of the more significant shifts is in the usage of articles ("gadri") such as ''lo'' and ''le''.

* [[How to use xorlo|The xorlo reform]], approved by the LLG in 2003 
* [[BPFK Section: gadri|BPFK on gadri]]

== Learning Lojban ==
These are resources made by Lojban speakers. Except where marked as LLG publications, they represent the personal views of their authors.

=== Courses and textbooks ===
* [[Lojban Wave Lessons|The Wave Lessons]] — the most popular textbook. Covers newer usage such as xorlo and dotside.
* [[Lojban For Beginners, The Book|Lojban for Beginners]] — an older course teaching CLL Lojban. Still largely valid, and full of insight into why the language is the way it is.
* [https://lojban.io/courses/introduction/ Getting Started with Lojban] — a modern, gentle course based on the Wave Lessons, with Duolingo-style interactive exercises.
* [https://lojban.pw/en/books/learn-lojban/ Learn Lojban] by la gleki — a newer, actively maintained course.
* [[la karda]] — a distilled, fast-paced overview of the grammar in small pieces.
* [https://cogas.github.io/hajiloji/ My First Lojban] by la .cogas. — a course in Japanese, with a [https://lynn.github.io/hajiloji/ partial English translation].
* [[pronunciation|Pronunciation guides]] — start here if you want to say things out loud.

=== Parsers and grammar checkers ===
Lojban is machine parsable, so you can check your own sentences.
* [https://lojban.github.io/ilmentufa/camxes.html ilmentufa (camxes)] — the modern parser, with modes for standard and experimental grammars. There is also a [https://lojban.github.io/ilmentufa/glosser/glosser.htm version with glosses and syntax highlighting].
* [https://camxes.lojban.org/ Visual camxes] — the same standard grammar, displayed graphically.
* [https://jboski.lojban.org/ jboski / jbofihe] — an older CLL-grammar parser whose output many people still find the easiest to read.

=== Dictionaries ===
* [https://jbovlaste.lojban.org jbovlaste] — the LLG-hosted collaborative dictionary database. You can register, add words, and vote on definitions; the dictionaries below are largely built on its data.
* [https://la-lojban.github.io/sutysisku/lojban/index.html#&bangu=en la sutysisku] — a fast multilingual word search that also works offline, with a searchable sentence database.
* [https://vlasisku.lojban.org/ la vlasisku] — a long-standing English-oriented word search.
* [https://sisku.org/?en la lidysisku] and [https://paclatkerlo.com la traide sisku] — newer, faster alternatives; the latter also shows the notes attached to each word.
* [[Word frequency lists|Word lists ordered by frequency of use]] and an unofficial [[Simple gismu|list of simple gismu definitions]].
* [https://guskant.github.io/lojbo/stardict.html StarDict dictionaries in several languages] (for [https://goldendict.org/ GoldenDict] and similar) and [https://guskant.github.io/lojbo/gismu-cmavo.html multilingual gismu and cmavo lists] in TSV and HTML.

=== Reading practice ===
* [[la .teris. po'u lo tirxu cu vitke zi'o le barda tcadu|Terry the Tiger]] — short and easy, with audio.
* [[le cmalu noltru|The Little Prince]], translated by la .xorxes.
* [https://lynn.github.io/la-melbi-e-le-ractu/ la melbi .e le ractu] — a story built from the 60 most common gismu and 60 most common cmavo.
* [https://selpahi.de/ Texts by la solpahi] — translations including Snow White and [https://selpahi.de/oz_plain.html The Wonderful Wizard of Oz], plus original poems and comics.
* [[te gerna la lojban|More Lojban texts on this wiki]].

==Connect with the community==
[[Image:yt-ro lo maha datka.png|240x160px|«ro lo ma'a datka» and other Lojban songs by [[la guskant]]|link=https://vimeo.com/album/3152276|thumb]]
Lojban is spoken by a vibrant community, producing literature, music, and art, and discussing questions about language and thought. The web comic [https://www.xkcd.com/191/ xkcd] said that, if you spoke Lojban, you'd have to speak with Lojbanists. That may not be such a bad thing!

=== Chat ===
'''[https://discord.com/invite/dGP5A6Fpj7 roljbogu'e]''' on Discord is where most day-to-day Lojban activity now happens. Ask questions in '''#ckule''', talk in or about Lojban in '''#lojban''', speak only Lojban in '''#jbosnu''', and chat about anything else in '''#jboselbau'''. Answers usually arrive within hours, often within minutes.

An older bridged chat also still exists on [https://t.me/joinchat/BLVsYz3hCF8mCAb6fzW1Rw Telegram] (with history back to 2016), though it is much quieter. See [[Lojban Live Chat]] for other ways to connect.

== Other community-run websites ==
The LLG hosts this wiki and lojban.org, but a great deal of Lojban lives elsewhere. These sites are built and maintained independently by members of the community; they are not LLG publications, and the LLG does not vouch for their contents.

{| class="wikitable"
! Site !! What it is
|-
| [https://lojban.io lojban.io] || A free, open-source learning platform with interactive courses, vocabulary decks, an FAQ, and a [https://lojban.io/resources/ regularly updated catalogue] of Lojban resources. Also carries community news.
|-
| [https://wiki.lojban.io wiki.lojban.io] || The wiki of the roljbogu'e Discord server, documenting modern usage and grammar proposals as they are actually spoken today.
|-
| [https://lojban.pw lojban.pw] || la gleki's site, home of the actively maintained ''Learn Lojban'' course.
|-
| [https://selpahi.de selpahi.de] || la solpahi's translations, original texts, poetry and comics, plus [https://solpahi.wordpress.com/ a blog] of influential grammar proposals.
|-
| [https://guskant.github.io/lojbo/ guskant.github.io] || la guskant's dictionaries, word lists, and the [https://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/zantufa-1.html zantufa] parser.
|-
| [https://nalvai.github.io/ NALVAI] || A dictionary project that documents words with real-world usage quotations.
|-
| [https://la-lojban.github.io/sutysisku/lojban/ la sutysisku] || The offline-capable multilingual dictionary and sentence search.
|-
| [https://jackhumbert.github.io/zbalermorna/write-up/ zbalermorna] || The de facto native script of Lojban, widely seen in Lojban artwork.
|}

If you maintain a Lojban site that isn't listed here, please add it — or mention it in [https://discord.com/invite/dGP5A6Fpj7 roljbogu'e] and someone will.

== What's next? ==
* Read Lojban [[te gerna la lojban|texts]], starting short and working up.
* Try translating something, or write your own — poetry, prose, blog posts, songs.
* Keep building vocabulary with [[Lojbanic Software|memorization software]] or the [https://lojban.io/decks/ lojban.io decks].
* Help expand the [https://jbovlaste.lojban.org/ dictionary] by translating Lojban words into other languages, or coining and adding new compounds.
* Support the LLG so this site stays online — see [[Logical Language Group]].
